title: Policy scope: application-level (recommended default) or per-path elicited
context: Cloudflare Access binds a policy at the application level (one policy protects every path) or per-path. Application-level scope is the most common shape.
decision: Recommended default is application-level (recommendedDefault: true); the elicited alternative is per-path. Standards trace clause: Cloudflare Access policy actions and rule selectors.
consequences: A fresh project applying the blueprint gets one application-level policy; an operator opting into per-path scope elicits a route table.
